name: valency
description: Use Valency to search, discover, and analyze tens of millions of research papers and preprints through Valency Bond.

interface.shortDescription: Search and analyze research papers and preprints through the Valency Bond MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Use the Valency Bond MCP server to search and analyze tens of millions of papers and preprints, explore authors and collaboration networks, map research landscapes and trends, find similar work, and build reading lists.
defaultPrompt: Map the research landscape for a topic, including trends, leading authors, and representative papers.
Find papers related to a title, DOI, PMID, or arXiv ID.
Profile an author and identify promising new collaborators outside their existing coauthor network.
